prompt: Generate a 3:4 vertical minimalist advertisement for Bolon eyewear. The background is a large area of warm white, with more than 60% white space. A pair of champagne gold thin-frame Bolon glasses is suspended below the center, the frame casting clean and soft geometric shadows. The left lens is slightly blurred, with only a golden question mark inside; the right lens is transparent and bright, showing a clear straight road and distant morning light. In the upper right corner of the frame, only an adult Asian woman's red lips, chin, and two slender fingers are visible as she gently removes the glasses, with the person naturally cropped by the canvas edge. Small brand text is placed in the upper left: 'BOLON'. Large black high-contrast serif font is used in the center, strictly divided into two lines: 'Poor vision, Lenses to the rescue.'. The bottom simply reads: 'See the world clearly, see yourself clearly.'. The overall style refers to international high-end eyewear brand minimalist ads, with soft top lighting and sharp product edges. Prohibit complex backgrounds, full human faces, excessive decoration, garbled text, and cheap promotional elements.

promptZh: 生成一张 3:4 竖版极简主义 BOLON 眼镜 产品广告。背景为大面积暖白色，留白超过 60%。一副 香槟金细框 BOLON 眼镜悬浮在画面中心下方，镜框投射出干净柔和的几何阴影。左侧镜片略微模糊，内部仅有一个金色问号；右侧镜片清晰明亮，呈现出远方笔直的道路和晨光。镜框右上角仅露出一位成年亚裔女性的红唇、下巴和两根纤细的手指，她正轻轻摘下眼镜，人物自然地被画布边缘裁剪。左上角放置小型品牌文字：“BOLON Eyewear”。画面中心使用超大号黑色高对比度衬线字体，严格分为两行：“视力不佳， 镜片来拯救。” 底部仅写着：“看清世界，看清自己。” 整体参考国际高端眼镜品牌的极简广告风格，采用柔和的顶部光线和锐利的产品边缘。禁止使用复杂的背景、完整的人脸、过度的装饰、乱码文字以及廉价的促销元素。
